description:
Create a new knowledge base article in the Solutions module of ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus. 

Goal: Document a fix for a VPN issue.

Details:
- Topic: General
- Title: "VPN Connection Drops After Windows 11 Update KB5034441"
- Content/Description:
  "Issue: Users experience intermittent VPN disconnections after installing Windows 11 cumulative update KB5034441.
  Root Cause: The update modifies the Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) callout drivers.
  Resolution Steps:
  1. Open Command Prompt as Administrator.
  2. Run: netsh winsock reset
  3. Run: netsh int ip reset
  4. Restart computer."
- Keywords: VPN, Windows 11, KB5034441, network
- Status: Publish/Approve the solution (do not leave as Draft).

Navigate to the Solutions tab, click 'New Solution', fill in the details, and Save/Publish.
